show.description: Dumped at the marriage registrar for a richer man, a struggling engineer marries a stranger—unaware she’s a billionaire CEO. Soon, he discovers he is the long-lost heir to a powerful business empire. As love and rivalry collide, he must choose between revenge and the woman who stood by him.
